text: ui-settings-skills（DSH Web 插件）：在 Web 设置中按工作区查看和管理技能。它将技能目录汇总到各工作区标签页，并提供名称或描述搜索、来源范围标记和启用开关。用户级技能的开关作用于所有工作区，项目技能可逐工作区控制；状态保存在设置策略中，并由技能 provider 应用于目录与调用入口。适合需要整理 DSH 技能可见性和按项目切换技能的用户。运行需要 DSH 的技能、工作区、设置与 Web 服务。

ui-settings-skills is a DSH Web plugin for managing skills by workspace. It offers tabs, search, source labels, and enable switches. User skills toggle globally and project skills per workspace. Settings retain the policy, which updates skill availability in DSH.
想按工作区查看 DSH 中有哪些技能
我想搜索技能名称或描述并快速找到对应项
让不同项目分别启用或停用自己的技能
用户级技能能不能一次切换并应用到所有工作区？
I want to manage which skills are enabled for each workspace.
Can I search installed skills by name or description in Web Settings?
ui-settings-skills 的功能「工作区技能目录」：每个工作区显示独立标签页，并把全局和用户级技能合并到各工作区视图。
ui-settings-skills 的功能「技能搜索」：在当前工作区的技能列表中按名称或描述过滤，便于定位条目。
ui-settings-skills 的功能「分范围开关」：用户级技能可全局启停，项目技能按当前工作区启停，策略写入设置文档。
ui-settings-skills 的功能「停用技能生效」：策略 provider 为停用项提供不可调用的替代条目，并更新相关技能目录。
想在设置页里管理用户技能和项目技能
How can I disable a skill in one project without changing other workspaces?

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · ui-settings-skills：A dsh plugin that adds a **Skill management** page to Web Settings, organized by workspace.

Built as a fully out-of-tree plugin — the deepseek-harness source stays untouched. It registers a `settings.section` slot (the page appears in Settings → **技能 / Skills**) and serves its skill catalog over its own HTTP route (`ctx.webServer`).

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Install：1. Install the plugin from npm (published as `@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills`):

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills
   ```

The package declares `dsh.bundle` (its bundled `cordis.patch.yml`), so `dsh plugin add` automatically appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer stack and the plugin mounts on the next boot — **no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing**.

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Install：Upgrading an install that predates the bundle declaration: remove the legacy `ui-settings-skills` row from `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle layer now supplies it, and leaving both would mount the id twice.

2. Restart the profile (new plugins are discovered at boot), then open Settings → **技能 / Skills**.

pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Features：- One tab per workspace, with global and user-level skills folded into every workspace view
- **Manages only user-level skills (`~/.agents/skills`) and project skills** — preset-loaded (`custom`) and built-in skills are never shown or toggled
- Search box that filters skills by name or description
- Localized scope badges on every row (用户 / User, 工作区 / Workspace)
- Skill descriptions clamp to two lines, with the full text shown on hover
- **Enable/disable toggles** on every managed row — see [Skill toggles](#skill-toggles)

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Skill toggles：Every managed skill row carries a switch. Turning a skill **off**:

- removes it from the model catalog (`tool-skill`) and the `/name` injection boundary,
- removes it from the `/` command menu in the conversation composer,
- takes effect immediately — the next `/` open reflects the change.

Scope semantics:

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Skill toggles：- **User-level skills** (`~/.agents/skills`) toggle globally across every workspace.
- **Project skills** toggle per workspace: the same skill can stay enabled in one workspace and disabled in another.

State persists in the settings document (`ui-settings-skills.policy` namespace), so it survives profile restarts, and turning a skill back **on** restores it everywhere.

> Preset-loaded (`custom`) and built-in skills are never managed and never shown on the page.

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Verify：```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | Select-String ui-settings-skills
```

The composed config shows the `ui-settings-skills` row, and `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` lists `@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills` under `dsh.profile.bundles` (auto-appended by `dsh plugin add`).

After the restart, the Skills page shows one tab per workspace, a search box, and localized skill rows.

@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills README · Config (optional)：The plugin runs in the `host` role by default (routes + settings namespace + shadowing provider). A `policy` role registers only the shadowing provider — no namespace, no routes. Override it from your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — the user layer is applied after the bundle layer, so an id-targeted patch overrides the bundled mount row:

```yaml
- id: ui-settings-skills
  name: "@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-settings-skills"
  config:
    role: policy      # default 'host'
